Gnosis Interpretation

NFCI below zero indicates looser-than-average broad financial conditions; -0.459 is the latest weekly observation for Oct 30, not a live reading.

Fed & Policy Watch
  • The immediate policy-sensitive event is CPI Tue Nov 10 at 8:30 AM ET. The New York Fed calendar dates CPI separately from PPI, which is Fri Nov 13 at 8:30 AM ET.
  • The Federal Reserve Board lists Veterans Day Wed Nov 11 and says daily and weekly statistical releases scheduled for that day move to Thu Nov 12. Its November schedule places H.4.1 at 4:30 PM and H.15 at 4:15 PM on Nov 12; EIA separately shifts the natural gas storage report to Fri Nov 13.
  • The Board lists FOMC minutes for the Oct 27-28 meeting on Nov 18 at 2:00 PM ET. The checked FOMC calendar lists the next scheduled policy meeting Dec 8-9; the Board calendar places the decision at 2:00 PM and press conference at 2:30 PM on Dec 9.
  • Funding and conditions are lagged observations: SOFR 3.89% effective Nov 6, NFCI -0.459 for the week ending Oct 30, MOVE 85.98 on Nov 9, and the official 10-year Treasury close 4.88% on Nov 9.
Omissions and Watch
  • Calendar cutoff is Tue Nov 10, 2026 12:30:46 AM ET; every displayed timed item is strictly later. Today's table is selected material coverage; routine Board statistical releases, including Commercial Paper, are not listed. November Employment Situation (Nov 6) and other elapsed releases are excluded from both calendar and future summary.
  • Conflict check: checked New York Fed and BEA calendars agree that GDP Second Estimate and Personal Income and Outlays (PCE) are Nov 25 at 8:30 AM ET. BEA specifies Q3 2026 and October 2026, respectively; the New York Fed entry does not state the periods. CPI and PPI are distinct releases on Nov 10 and Nov 13. NAR's schedule confirms October Existing-Home Sales Nov 12 and October Pending Home Sales Nov 18; the New York Fed calendar supplies the release times.
  • Timing source for BLS releases is the New York Fed Economic Indicators Calendar; bls.gov was not requested. Periods are marked not stated where the checked calendar does not give one. The Veterans Day item is date-only because the Board supplies no time.
  • Selected material events only: routine data releases, some Treasury bill auctions and other scheduled items are not exhaustive. TreasuryDirect returned bill auction records without a verified competitive close time, so no bill auction is given a timed row.
  • Unmatched classifier events (Federal Reserve Veterans Day holiday, Initial Claims, Weekly Economic Index, SCE Credit Access Survey, Imports and Exports, and Industrial Production) are provisional Medium and explicitly flagged. Impact self-test passed; no overrides used. CPI is High and PPI is Medium.
  • No verified watch item from this run for unscheduled geopolitical or policy risks; this is not a full headline-risk review. Check fresh event notices, liquidity and contract specifications before execution.
  • Checked primary sources: New York Fed November and December Economic Indicators calendars, SOFR API and Empire State Survey; Federal Reserve Board November/December calendars, FOMC calendar and H.4.1; BEA release schedule; Census 2026 indicator calendar; NAR release schedule; Philadelphia Fed MBOS release calendar; Chicago Fed NFCI and release calendar; TreasuryDirect auction data and U.S. Treasury yield CSV; EIA petroleum and natural gas schedules. Snapshot quotes are single-source Yahoo Finance vendor charts, not official settlement; quote times and prior daily bars are stated above.
Trading Strategy Note | ES Futures
BASE CASE
Event-sensitive two-way risk into CPI: SPY gained 2.37% at Monday's vendor close and the generic ES=F quote is 0.15% above Monday's prior bar. VIX is 19.92 and MOVE 85.98, still within the moderate uncertainty band. The official 10-year yield rose 2 bp to 4.88%. Treat overnight strength as context, not confirmation; monitor rates, breadth and liquidity after the 8:30 AM ET release and around the 1:00 PM 10-year auction. Scenario framing only, not a trade signal.
INVALIDATION
Reassess if CPI or rates sharply reprices policy expectations, volatility expands against the overnight move, or ES moves without confirmation from rates, breadth or depth. No unsupported levels or targets are supplied. Verify the intended contract, current event updates and fresh quotes before execution.
